text:
emily_park: Uploading the final asset pack for our Zenith co-marketing push. Need quick sign-offs on: logo lockups, color palette, one-pager copy, Cloudline quote usage, marketplace tile exports, and alt text. Drive link: https://drive.company/partners/zenith/pack (preview in folder). Please scan for any legal/comms flags.
matt_b: Quick Q — do we have high-res SVGs for the vertical lockup? The pack I saw had a rasterized PNG only.
katie.design: I just added new SVGs + 3 crop variants to the folder. Filenames below:
```
zenith_logo_primary.svg
zenith_logo_horizontal.svg
zenith_lockup_cloudline.svg
zenith_onepager_v3.pdf
zenith_marketplace_tile_1x.png
```
Clearspace guidance: 20% of lockup width (or 8px at 1x). Recommend horizontal lockup for hero placements.
oliver_legal: Need to confirm trademark line for the lockup and the signed quote release from Cloudline. @emily_park did we get written permission to use Cloudline's quote on the one-pager?
emily_park: Yes — Cloudline sent a signed quote release (PDF in folder under approvals/). Zenith requested a minor copy tweak on the quote — I flagged it to @julio_pm for product accuracy.
julio_pm: Saw the tweak. PMs approve replacing "sub-second" with "sub-200ms" in the quote for accuracy. Attached PM note in the folder.
katie.design: I'll update the one-pager text and regenerate exports by EOD. Also added proposed alt-text entries in assets/alt_texts.md — please review.
matt_b: Two quick asks: 1) color contrast on the callout box — current #f2f3f8 might not pass AA on small text. 2) need 2x PNG for marketplace tile (retina).
drive-bot: drive-bot: files uploaded to /partners/zenith/marketing/1749054321/ (svg, pdf, png, approvals/)
oliver_legal: Also want a short attribution: "Zenith is a registered trademark of Zenith Compute, Inc." Where should we place it? Footer or license page?
emily_park: Footer is fine. Marketing please ensure placement and size. Can we get final OKs from @katie.design and @oliver_legal by tomorrow 10:00am PST? We aim to hand off to marketplace publishing by 11am.
katie.design: :thumbsup: I'll deliver updated art (dark/light bg variants) + export spec sheet by 9:30am.
oliver_legal: I'll confirm the trademark line and check the quote release. Note: any specific comparative or superlative claims (e.g., "lowest latency") need a citation. @matt_b please attach the benchmark link.
matt_b: Benchmark link: http://internal-bench/zenith-latency-report-2026 — adding a one-line footnote to the one-pager pointing to the report.
katie.design: Small design preference from Zenith: neutral/light background for co-logo lockup. I'll produce both neutral and dark variants so we have options for marketplace and site.
emily_park: Confirmed: produce neutral/light as primary. Also need the following exports: 16:9 hero PNG, 1:1 marketplace tile, SVG lockups, and a marketplace-specific 600x400 PNG.
julio_pm: Reminder — do not include internal feature flags or roadmap language in the collateral. Keep product messaging high-level and outcome-focused.
matt_b: Noted. Also adding a short technical footnote about test setup for the latency claim.
katie.design: Done — updated color for callout to #e6e9f1 (better contrast) and exported 2x PNGs. Uploading now.
drive-bot: drive-bot: new files uploaded to /partners/zenith/marketing/1749054321/final_exports/
oliver_legal: I approve the trademark placement + quote use pending the footnote citation. Will post a quick sign-off comment in the approvals PDF.
emily_park: Thanks all. If nobody objects by 10am PST tomorrow we proceed to marketplace submission and partner co-publish schedule. Ping me for any last-minute changes. :rocket:
katie.design: Signed off from design side.
matt_b: Sign-off from engineering (bench citations added).
julio_pm: Product sign-off.
oliver_legal: Legal sign-off (minor footnote fix done).
emily_park: Great — moving to publish queue. Appreciate the quick turnaround!"
